description: UX B (olife_menu, 16.10): the client's main menu and the login status screen (agents/OLIFE_UX.md §8 p.1-2). F2F 0.32 test build runs the pack's app script (= «Сценарии» -> olife): the menu page (VCM 3D scene, the camera turns, fields pre-filled from export:olife_server.txt), «Войти» -> the status page shows every phase (ticket, gateway, Welcome, manifest, downloads with files/bytes/current file, sha256, replica world with world:content + reopen, first chunks, play); in the game the HUD status shows packs on the fly (live and with a world reopen) and «мир перезапускается, держитесь» with the reconnect phases. Errors on the same screen with code and reason + Повторить/Назад: no server (tcp), gateway silent (Welcome timeout), auth service down (http 0) -> Повторить after it is back, bad token (auth), ban (lab olife ban -> unban -> Повторить), whitelist (on -> whitelist -> add -> Повторить), nick of a token account (nick_reserved), file changed after the manifest (HTTP 409), sha256 mismatch (a proxy swaps a file of the pack distribution). Gates are the status lines/state (F2F `menu`), not pixels; shots are evidence.
